name: LE, Dai Trang

headline.note: Full-time status is now explicitly supported for the Liverpool cadetship, but its start conflict and missing end prevent a duration. Fairfield newspaper and ABC working patterns remain unknown. Earlier hospitality/retail jobs are recorded with unknown dates. Business entity, post-2008 work and leave gaps remain unresolved; excluded activities and missing evidence are not counted as zero.

career_spells.role: Factory work ironing branded T-shirts and assembling watches while a child refugee
career_spells.evidence_note: In a first-person ABC account, Le states that she left the Hong Kong refugee camp each day to work in a factory, ironing branded T-shirts and assembling watches, when she was ten. The employer, pay, exact dates, hours and coercive circumstances are not identified.
career_spells.counting_note: The work is retained as career-history evidence but cannot be classified or counted as documented adult full-time employment.

career_spells.employer: Liverpool City Champion (Fairfax Community Media network)
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen journalism start is 1991; secondary reporting gives 1990 for this cadetship, so that conflict remains explicit. Money’s first-person interview identifies the Liverpool cadet job as full-time; ABC’s interview independently corroborates her first newspaper job as full-time. Cadetship end is unknown. The prior combined newspaper interval ended in 1994 at the reported ABC transition; that does not establish when this particular job ended.
career_spells.counting_note: Explicit full-time status is supported, but unresolved start conflict, cessation, leave and later newspaper transition prevent a defensible duration. No full-time status transferred to Fairfield or ABC.

career_spells.employer: Fairfield City Champion (Fairfax Community Media network)
career_spells.evidence_note: Member biography and secondary chronology identify this subsequent newspaper role before ABC. The 1994 end is the previously recorded year-only ABC transition; exact dates, separate employer contract, overlap with Liverpool, hours and leave remain unresolved. Split from original combined newspaper spell to avoid extending cadetship full-time evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: Later newspaper hours unknown; no duration calculated.

career_spells.role: Researcher, journalist, film-maker, reporter, producer and broadcaster
career_spells.evidence_note: Le's current biography describes progression from an ABC researcher role into reporting and broadcasting. An archived Australia Vietnam Leadership Dialogue profile calls her a former ABC journalist, film-maker and broadcaster; secondary synthesis reports ABC service from 1994 to 2008 across television and radio. The frozen extract confirms the overall journalism endpoint in 2008, but exact start/end dates, hours, appointment basis, leave and internal role transitions remain unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: ABC is government-controlled, but a long professional career and senior duties do not alone establish a countable full-time interval.

career_spells.employer: Vincent Fairfax Ethics and Leadership Fellowship Program
career_spells.evidence_note: Secondary synthesis reports selection for the 1996–1997 fellowship and travel during the program. It does not establish employment, hours or how the fellowship overlapped ABC work.
career_spells.counting_note: Professional development/fellowship activity is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: Member and secondary accounts identify Le as the Liberal candidate at the 18 October 2008 by-election. The nomination date, remuneration, campaign hours and relationship to the end of ABC employment are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.role: Candidate for Cabramatta at the NSW election

career_spells.counting_note: Party candidacy and campaigning are excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Multicultural NSW (formerly NSW Community Relations Commission)
career_spells.evidence_note: Archived organisational and secondary profiles report appointment to the state-government advisory board in August 2012. The end date, remuneration and workload are unresolved; advisory governance is not assumed to be employment. Primary2012/13 report specifies appointment1August2012 and lists Le among part-time commissioners. Scheduled expiry1August2015 is not confirmed cessation; end remains unknown. Category corrected to public service for this government body; advisory governance remains excluded. Primary2021/22 annual report, visually verified printed page10/PDFpage12, explicitly records retirement5August2021. This is observed cessation, not merely an earlier scheduled expiry.
career_spells.counting_note: Government advisory-board service is excluded from the narrow employment headline.

career_spells.role: Councillor for Cabravale Ward, then Fairfield/Cabravale Ward
career_spells.evidence_note: The Fairfield heritage record and member biography corroborate council service since 2012; secondary election chronology supplies 9 September 2012 and the 4 December 2021 ward transition. The office continued after federal election and was current at the frozen snapshot.
career_spells.counting_note: Local elected office is excluded under the codebook.

career_spells.employer: Unidentified business venture(s), associated publicly with media and leadership initiatives
career_spells.evidence_note: The frozen official extract provides only 'Business owner from 2014 to 2022'. Public biographies identify several DAWN/media, leadership and entrepreneurial initiatives but do not reliably identify which legal entity or activity the official business-owner interval denotes. Hours, revenue/remuneration, leave, exact boundaries and overlap with cancer treatment, council and governance roles are unresolved. Follow-up finds Dawn Media Productions Pty Ltd as a declared-shareholding lead and matching ABR company name. Neither source maps the entire 2014–2022 employment interval to it; ownership is not labour, and ABN cancellation is not an employment end.
career_spells.counting_note: Business ownership does not by itself prove self-employment or substantive full-time work.

career_spells.evidence_note: An archived Australia Vietnam Leadership Dialogue profile identifies Le as founder and CEO and explicitly describes DAWN as a nonprofit association; a 2016 ABC author note corroborates her as founder. Exact formation/cessation dates, remuneration, hours and relationship to the frozen business-owner spell are unresolved. First-person13February2018 article dates founding to January2014; no full-time hours or cessation established.
career_spells.counting_note: Nonprofit leadership is displayed separately and excluded from the narrow public/private employment headline.

research_notes: The frozen official 1991 journalism start is retained as the headline boundary for the first newspaper spell even though secondary reporting says the cadet role began in 1990; the discrepancy is explicit rather than silently resolved.
ABC is coded as a public corporation under government control, but no full-time duration is calculated because available biographies do not state hours or employment status.

The unidentified 2014–2022 business-owner spell is not conflated with DAWN: the available organisation profile describes DAWN as a nonprofit association, while the official extract does not name the business entity.
Council, deputy-mayor, party/campaign, advisory and board roles are displayed but excluded from the narrow employment headline.
Public sources do not establish whether 2014–2015 cancer treatment interrupted or reduced any business, council or nonprofit work.

2026-10-01 follow-up adds four early hospitality/retail jobs and brief Sydney law study. Explicit full-time Liverpool cadetship evidence is isolated from later newspaper/ABC work; no duration inferred from rounded career descriptions.

Searched ABC employer material, first-person interviews, company and interest records. Money interview and ABC transcript readable. Direct ABR company record and original 47P parliamentary interest PDF inaccessible; indexed legal-entity/shareholding leads retained without claiming verification of employment dates. Searches did not resolve 2008–2014 paid-work gap or treatment-related leave.

Second follow-up2October2026 identifies omitted Beloka marketing role, resolves DAWN founding month and CRC appointment day/part-time status, and improves governance observations. All added activity remains uncounted; public/private totals remain unknown. CRC PDF reader failed internally but ordinary direct PDF download succeeded; table visually checked. Further leads: Beloka personnel/contract history, ABC hours and leave, unidentified2008–2014 work, DAWN legal entity and workload, and original STARTTS appointment. Do not substitute award dates, scheduled board expiry or annual-report observation dates for employment boundaries.

Follow-up3October2026 resolves Multicultural NSW retirement5August2021 using visually checked original2021/22 report; adds previously omitted Global Sisters board and two ambassador affiliations. Beloka title searches yielded already-known award observations, not contract dates. STARTTS initial appointment remains unknown.2018/19 government dataset PDF returned404; later original report accessible. Public LinkedIn999 retained as source-access limitation; indexed board dates explicitly labelled. Next leads remain Beloka/ABC personnel records, STARTTS appointment, legal entity/workload of DAWN and unverified Global Sisters conditions.
open_questions: What were the exact start/end dates, hours, leave and employment terms at the Liverpool City Champion, Fairfield City Champion and ABC, and how should the 1990 versus 1991 start discrepancy be resolved?
What paid work, if any, occurred between leaving the ABC in 2008 and the official business-owner start in 2014?
Which legal entity and activities comprise the official 2014–2022 business-owner spell, and what were ownership, remuneration, hours, leave and exact boundaries?
Did cancer treatment in 2014–2015 create a break or reduced-hours interval in business or other work?
What were the dates, remuneration and workload for DAWN, Multicultural NSW, STARTTS, the Ethnic Communities Council and any DAWN Media Productions activity?
Were the 2008, 2011 or 2022 campaigns remunerated, and what employment overlapped those campaigns?
When did the full-time Liverpool cadetship end, and when did Fairfield newspaper work begin; was the latter also full-time?
Which employers and dates apply to the restaurant, waitressing, nightclub and Katies roles?
Can original interest/company records distinguish Dawn Foundation, the DAWN network and Dawn Media Productions employment and ownership intervals?
When did the Beloka Water CMO role begin/end, was it employment or consultancy, with what hours and breaks, and did it overlap the2014–2022 business-owner activity?

What appointment instruments, remuneration and workload apply to Global Sisters March–November2015 board service, and what are the dates/pay basis and relationship of the two Cancer Council/Relay for Life ambassador roles?
